title: Lantern Garden
blurb: A dusky garden of paper lanterns, flowers and fireflies. Light them all, at your own pace.

levels.name: Garden Gate
levels.intro: Welcome to the garden. Light every paper lantern hanging under the arch.

levels.name: Petal Path
levels.intro: Clear every peg from the flower bed. New: a multiball peg sends out two more balls.

levels.name: Firefly Meadow
levels.intro: Catch the fireflies. Break thirty pegs. New: an extra ball peg gives you one more ball.

levels.name: Stepping Stones
levels.intro: Follow the stepping stones and light the lanterns. New: lightning lights the pegs nearby.

levels.name: Rose Terraces
levels.intro: Pick the red roses. Break every red peg along the terraces.

levels.name: Diamond Hedges
levels.intro: Trim the hedges. New: green hedge bricks break when your ball hits them.

levels.name: Lantern Heart
levels.intro: Light the lanterns around the heart. New: a spray peg makes your next shot three balls.

levels.name: Evening Dew
levels.intro: Collect the dewdrop gems resting on the leaves. New: double points peg.

levels.name: Wind Chimes
levels.intro: Ring the chimes to reach the target score. The plate bounces today. New: springy bumpers.

levels.name: Sunflowers
levels.intro: Make a chain of ten hits in one shot. New: a fireball burns right through pegs.

levels.name: Moon Gate
levels.intro: Hit the blue key to open the moon gate, then light the lanterns. New: keys open gates.

levels.name: Falling Leaves
levels.intro: Sweep up every leaf. New: a blast peg makes your next ball burst on its first hit.

levels.name: Glasshouse
levels.intro: Break all the glass and the flower pots. New: glass shatters at the first touch.

levels.name: Weeping Willow
levels.intro: Break forty pegs from the willow. New: a safety net bounces your next ball back up.

levels.name: Brook Bridge
levels.intro: Find the river stone gems along the brook. New: portals send your ball to their twin.

levels.name: Firefly Dance
levels.intro: Light the lanterns while fireflies circle them. New: some pegs move, slowly.

levels.name: Pinwheel Bloom
levels.intro: The pinwheel flower turns slowly. Make a chain of twelve hits in one shot.

levels.name: Night Blossoms
levels.intro: Break every pink blossom on the branches. New: the super guide shows a long aiming line.

levels.name: Lantern Strings
levels.intro: Light the lanterns on the swaying strings.

levels.name: Festival of Light
levels.intro: The garden festival. Light all the lanterns, with powers all around to help.
